subject.title: fix(doctor): repair ALTER-appended operator approval schema instead of wedging startup

question: May doctor discard legacy operator-approval rows whose `resolution_ref` cannot satisfy the current canonical constraint while repairing this shipped upgrade shape?
rationale: The code can implement either policy, but choosing between startup recovery and preservation of noncanonical persisted approvals is an upgrade-compatibility decision that should remain explicit.

options.title: Accept transient-row discard
options.body: Land the current repair because invalid or pre-reference approvals cannot be represented canonically and should not keep gateway startup wedged.

options.title: Preserve every row
options.body: Pause and define a trustworthy canonical reference backfill before rebuilding, accepting that affected upgrades remain blocked until that policy is implemented.

recommendation.title: Accept transient-row discard
recommendation.body: Land the current repair because invalid or pre-reference approvals cannot be represented canonically and should not keep gateway startup wedged.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR and production verification show direct ownership of this migration decision and its affected database.
